verdict.rationale: Green and Spiegel is an immigration law firm offering legal services such as visas, green cards and compliance work, not a software product. An interactive API reference with runnable examples is a category error for this kind of business. The OpenAPI and llms.txt probes returning 404 match this; the evidence shows no developer API of any kind.
